same_binary_controls.interpretation: The shadow is the same binary and is a process/control observation, not another independent candidate sample. The two anchor rows are alternate coordinate calibrations of the same run.

nearest_zero_share_frontier_edges.method: For each positive projected coordinate, hold the other axis fixed and find the first actual 29954 frontier point that dominates as that axis worsens; verify score=0 at equality and positive at the immediately interior floating-point value.
nearest_zero_share_frontier_edges.no_combined_distance: Time and compression axes have different units; exact per-axis distances are reported without an arbitrary weighting or stress scenario.
